headline: Is IDEX (IEX) Pricey Following Earnings And Buyback News?
summary: IDEX (IEX) just released second quarter and first half 2026 results, along with an update on its long running share repurchase program, giving investors fresh numbers to evaluate the stock. See our latest analysis for IDEX. Recent earnings and buyback news come as IDEX trades at US$230.45, with the share price up 28.7% year to date and a 1 year total shareholder return of 46.98%.
